    <variable name="q_us_wCont" units="m3" interface="public"/>

    <variable name="Delta_C" units="dimensionless" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="C_wCont" units="m6_per_J" interface="public"/>

        <apply>
          <diff/>
          <bvar>
            <ci>t</ci>
          </bvar>
          <ci>v</ci>
        </apply>
        <apply>
          <divide/>
          <apply>
            <minus/>
            <apply>
              <minus/>
              <ci>u</ci>
              <ci>u_out</ci>
            </apply>
            <apply>
              <times/>
              <ci>R</ci>
              <ci>v</ci>
            </apply>

          <ci>I</ci>

        <apply>

          <ci>v_in</ci>
          <ci>v</ci>

      <!-- TODO CHECK THAT CHANGING US VOLUME LIKE THIS CONSERVES VOLUME!!!!-->

        <eq/>
        <ci>q_C</ci>
        <apply>

      </apply>
      <apply>

          <ci>u_ext</ci>

      </apply>

        <apply>
          <times/>
          <pi/>

            <power/>
            <ci>r_0</ci>

          </apply>
          <ci>l</ci>

 R = 8{dimensionless}*mu*l/(pi*pow(r, 4{dimensionless}));-->
      <apply>

        <ci>I</ci>

          <apply>

            <times/>

          <apply>
            <times/>
            <pi/>

            <minus/>

              <minus/>

                <ci>R_flag</ci>

                <ci>v</ci>

            </apply>
            <apply>
              <times/>

      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>

          <diff/>

            <ci>q_C</ci>
            <ci>C</ci>
          </apply>
          <ci>u_ext</ci>
        </apply>
      </apply>

          <apply>
            <times/>
            <ci>M_rg_trv</ci>
            <ci>A_nn_trv</ci>

          <apply>
            <times/>
            <ci>M_rg_puv</ci>

        <ci>A_eff_miv</ci>

          <apply>

                <ci>M_rg_miv</ci>

            <ci>zeta_miv</ci>
          </apply>
          <apply>
            <times/>
            <ci>M_rg_miv</ci>
            <ci>A_nn_miv</ci>
          </apply>
        </apply>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>A_eff_aov</ci>
        <apply>
          <plus/>
          <apply>
            <times/>
            <apply>
              <minus/>
              <apply>
                <times/>
                <ci>M_st_aov</ci>
                <ci>A_nn_aov</ci>
              </apply>
              <apply>
                <times/>
                <ci>M_rg_aov</ci>
                <ci>A_nn_aov</ci>

            <ci>zeta_aov</ci>

          <apply>
            <times/>
            <ci>M_rg_aov</ci>

          <bvar>

        <piecewise>
          <piece>
            <apply>
              <times/>
              <apply>
                <minus/>
                <cn cellml:units="dimensionless">1</cn>
                <ci>zeta_miv_pre</ci>

      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <apply>
          <diff/>
          <bvar>
            <ci>t</ci>

        <piecewise>
          <piece>
            <apply>
              <times/>
              <apply>
                <minus/>
                <cn cellml:units="dimensionless">1</cn>

              <ci>K_vo_miv</ci>

                <ci>u_la</ci>

              <ci>u_la</ci>
              <ci>u_lv</ci>

              <ci>zeta_miv_pre</ci>

    </math>
    <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">

    <variable name="v_Ke_stim" units="fmol_per_s" interface="public" id="b4da56"/>

    <variable name="C_m" units="fF" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="stimDuration" units="second" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="stimPeriod" units="second" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="stimStart" units="second" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="stimVoltage" units="volt" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="tPeriod" units="second" interface="public"/>
    <variable name="I_stim" units="fA" interface="public" id="b4da58"/>
    <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:cellml="http://www.cellml.org/cellml/2.0#">
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>tPeriod</ci>
        <apply>
          <minus/>
          <ci>t</ci>
          <apply>
            <times/>
            <apply>
              <floor/>
              <apply>
                <divide/>
                <ci>t</ci>
                <ci>stimPeriod</ci>
              </apply>
            </apply>
            <ci>stimPeriod</ci>
          </apply>
        </apply>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>I_stim</ci>
        <piecewise>
          <piece>
            <apply>
              <divide/>
              <apply>
                <times/>
                <ci>stimVoltage</ci>
                <ci>C_m</ci>
              </apply>
              <ci>stimDuration</ci>
            </apply>
            <apply>
              <and/>
              <apply>
                <geq/>
                <ci>tPeriod</ci>
                <ci>stimStart</ci>
              </apply>
              <apply>
                <leq/>
                <ci>tPeriod</ci>
                <apply>
                  <plus/>
                  <ci>stimStart</ci>
                  <ci>stimDuration</ci>
                </apply>
              </apply>
            </apply>
          </piece>
          <otherwise>
            <cn cellml:units="fA">0</cn>
          </otherwise>
        </piecewise>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>v_Ki_stim</ci>
        <apply>
          <divide/>
          <ci>I_stim</ci>
          <ci>F</ci>
        </apply>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>v_Ke_stim</ci>
        <apply>
          <minus/>
          <apply>
            <divide/>
            <ci>I_stim</ci>
            <ci>F</ci>
          </apply>
        </apply>
      </apply>
      <apply>
        <eq/>
        <ci>I_mem_stim</ci>
        <ci>I_stim</ci>
      </apply>
    </math>
  </component>
</model>
